text:
Lena Ortiz: Heads up — partner 'BrightRoute' says they were billed twice for March on Azure Marketplace: one invoice shows full month, another shows adjustment for same subscription. They want immediate reconciliation.
Priya Singh: can you share both invoice ids and s3 links?
Lena Ortiz: INV-AZ-2026-03-7209 and INV-AZ-2026-03-7210. PDFs uploaded s3://redwood-prod/finance/marketplace/brightroute/INV-AZ-2026-03-7209.pdf and ...7210.pdf
Azure-Partner-Bot: Marketplace events: subscription_renewal at 2026-03-01T00:00Z and subscription_adjustment at 2026-03-01T00:05Z for same order id due to delayed meter.
Carlos M.: ledger look: ```sql
SELECT invoice_id, charge_type, amount, related_order
FROM marketplace_invoices
WHERE partner='BrightRoute' AND month='2026-03';
-- shows both invoices billed for subscription 2026-03-01-129 with amounts $2,400 and $-2,400 adjustment posted as separate invoice instead of netting, resulting in duplicate recognition in our system.```
Alicia B.: possible cause: our invoice stitching job didn't detect the adjustment invoice as a correction because it lacked original_invoice_id header. Azure sometimes sends adjustment as standalone when meter delay occurs.
FinanceBot: Reconciliation job RJ-745 flagged duplicate subscription billing for BrightRoute. Case RB-9995 created.
Priya Singh: next steps: 1) accounting to post netting entry and void duplicate where appropriate 2) contact Azure to confirm if adjustment should net or be separate (case AZ-61244) 3) notify partner and offer immediate credit if customer-facing impact.
Carlos M.: accounting, can you prepare reversing entry and credit memo CM-2026-03-BR-01 for $2,400 if needed?
Alicia B.: will draft reversing journal and CM template; need approval from revenue ops. tagging @rev-ops.
Azure-Partner-Bot: Azure support responded: adjustment was intended to net; they will reissue invoice metadata to include original_invoice_id and advise to re-run stitching.
Lena Ortiz: partner appreciates fast response; asks for ETA to see corrected invoice.
Priya Singh: ETA: accounting will post reversal within 2 business days after Azure provides corrected metadata; infra to add safer stitching rule to match by subscription+timestamp when original_invoice_id missing.
Alicia B.: opened INFRA-3225: "marketplace-stitching: fallback match on subscription+close-timestamp when original_invoice_id absent" and linked RB-9995.
FinanceBot: RB-9995 actions: ["post_reversal","await_azure_metadata","deploy_stitching_fix"]. reminder set for 2026-03-25.
Priya Singh: will update partner and close when reversal posts.
Lena Ortiz: thanks team — will follow up once accounting confirms.
